description: This Java class 'DefaultTbEntityRelationService' implements entity relation management functions such as saving, deleting, and deleting common relations within the Thingsboard platform. It interacts with the RelationService and logs actions accordingly.

classes.name: DefaultTbEntityRelationService
classes.description: Service class for managing entity relations, including saving and deleting relations, with logging and exception handling.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates an entity relation, logs the action, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific entity relation, logs the action, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: deleteCommonRelations
methods.description: Deletes all common relations for a given entity and logs the action.
